answer: In an agent market routing saffron from oasis farms, each agent must register through a ferrous tamper-resistant sensor module at a distinct physical depot, post refundable stake, and submit time-locked shipment telemetry co-signed by two nearby depots. A sybil farmer cannot spin up accounts freely: every fake identity needs separate certified hardware, a unique location that witnesses corroborate, and bonded coins. Clusters tied to one device or fabricating delivery records are flagged and slashed, turning a cheap software swarm into expensive procurement, collusion, and capital loss.
